NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 HPM
The NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 leverages two NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 host processor motherboards (HPMs) per
tray that integrate processors, memory and GPU accelerators in a powerful package.

Each of the NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 HPMs include one NVIDIA Grace processor, as part of the NVIDIA GB300
NVL72 module. The processors are standard in all confgi urations of the NVIDIA GB300 NVL72.
Each processor has the following features:
72 Arm Neoverse V2 cores with 4x 128b SVE2
Up to 3.1 GHz base frequency
3.0 GHz all-core SIMD frequency
L1 cache: 64KB i-cache + 64KB d-cache
L2 cache: 1MB per core
L3 cache: 114MB
64 PCIe Gen5 lanes (implemented as 8x x8)
300 GB/s bi-directional NVLink-C2C connectivity between processors
450 GB/s bi-directional NVLink connectivity to two GPUs each
NVIDIA Scalable Coherency Fabric (SCF) with 3.2 terabytes/s bisection bandwidth interconnecting
